business_summary: Hyosung ITX Co. Ltd provides contact center services and IT solutions in South Korea. The company offers IT solutions and services, such as system integration that includes the integration of tangible and intangible products, such as hardware, software, and networks with consulting, systems design and repair and maintenance for a comprehensive computing solution; big data services, content delivery network (CDN) services, infrastructure sales, and display solution services, such as the provision of beam projectors and digital cinema projectors to public institutions, schools, businesses, and theaters; content delivery network; and IDC services, as well as smart factory solutions, that includes research and design, purchase of raw materials, production, distribution, marketing, sales, management, service, etc. It is also involved in the operation of the contact center and provides in-house services, full-outsourcing services, and tailored total services; ASP services, such as workspace for the operation of the contact center, system infrastructure, and consultation apps; and consulting services, that includes building of the contact center, operation diagnosis service, and solution consulting, as well as xTrmSolution, an integration of AI technologies, which includes text analysis technology, such as speech to text, natural language processing, and business process outsourcing. In addition, the company provides cloud contact center solutions that include RingCloud, a cloud-based service and call-centered solution that provides expanded messaging service, customer relationship management service, and AI services, such as voice recognition; and display solution products to convention centers, commercial spaces, firms, educational institutions, public agencies, etc. HYOSUNGITX Co.,Ltd was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 효성ITX(주)는 한국에서 컨택센터 서비스와 IT 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 포괄적인 컴퓨팅 솔루션을 위한 컨설팅, 시스템 설계, 수리 및 유지 관리를 통해 하드웨어, 소프트웨어, 네트워크 등 유무형 제품의 통합을 포함하는 시스템 통합과 같은 IT 솔루션 및 서비스를 제공합니다. 빅데이터 서비스, 콘텐츠 전송 네트워크(CDN) 서비스, 인프라 판매, 공공 기관, 학교, 기업, 극장에 빔 프로젝터 및 디지털 시네마 프로젝터를 제공하는 등 디스플레이 솔루션 서비스; 콘텐츠 전달 네트워크; 연구 및 설계, 원자재 구매, 생산, 유통, 마케팅, 판매, 관리, 서비스 등을 포함하는 IDC 서비스와 스마트 팩토리 솔루션을 제공합니다. 또한 컨택센터 운영에 참여하고 사내 서비스, 풀 아웃소싱 서비스, 맞춤형 토털 서비스를 제공합니다. 컨택센터 운영을 위한 업무 공간, 시스템 인프라, 상담 앱 등 ASP 서비스 컨택센터 구축, 운영진단 서비스, 솔루션 등 컨설팅 서비스
